name: Heroine
source:
Role: Princess of the Pepsilla Kingdom
Specialities: Magic, swordsmanship
Weapon: Silver sword
Likes: Hunting, spending time with family, desserts
Dislikes: Social etiquette, arrogant nobility
Introduction: Originally a carefree princess, she took over kingship following the death of her father and older brother.
